title: Kay and Snowflake
statementMd:
After the piece of a devilish mirror hit the Kay's eye, he is no longer interested in the beauty of the roses. Now he likes to watch snowflakes.

Once upon a time, he found a huge snowflake that has a form of the tree (connected acyclic graph) consisting of $*n*$ nodes. The root of tree has index $1$. Kay is very interested in the structure of this tree.

After doing some research he formed $*q*$ queries he is interested in. The $*i*$-th query asks to find a centroid of the subtree of the node $*v*_{*i*}$. Your goal is to answer all queries.

*Subtree* of a node is a part of tree consisting of this node and all it's descendants (direct or not). In other words, subtree of node $*v*$ is formed by nodes $*u*$, such that node $*v*$ is present on the path from $*u*$ to root.

*Centroid* of a tree (or a subtree) is a node, such that if we erase it from the tree, the maximum size of the connected component will be at least two times smaller than the size of the initial tree (or a subtree).

## Input

The first line of the input contains two integers $*n*$ and $*q*$ ($2 ≤ *n* ≤ 300 000$, $1 ≤ *q* ≤ 300 000$) — the size of the initial tree and the number of queries respectively.

The second line contains $*n* - 1$ integer $*p*_{2}, *p*_{3}, ..., *p*_{*n*}$ ($1 ≤ *p*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$) — the indices of the parents of the nodes from $2$ to $*n*$. Node $1$ is a root of the tree. It's guaranteed that $*p*_{*i*}$ define a correct tree.

Each of the following $*q*$ lines contain a single integer $*v*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *v*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$) — the index of the node, that define the subtree, for which we want to find a centroid.

## Output

For each query print the index of a centroid of the corresponding subtree. If there are many suitable nodes, print any of them. It's guaranteed, that each subtree has at least one centroid.

## Note

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b6d1f35b3db16b3f662d8b452206abbdeb5d0aa4.png)

The first query asks for a centroid of the whole tree — this is node $3$. If we delete node $3$ the tree will split in four components, two of size $1$ and two of size $2$.

The subtree of the second node consists of this node only, so the answer is $2$.

Node $3$ is centroid of its own subtree.

The centroids of the subtree of the node $5$ are nodes $5$ and $6$ — both answers are considered correct.
statementZhMd:
在一块邪恶的镜子碎片击中 Kay 的眼睛后，他不再对玫瑰的美丽感兴趣了。现在，他喜欢观察雪花。

很久以前，他发现了一片巨大的雪花，它呈树（连通无环图）的形状，由 $*n*$ 个节点组成。树的根节点编号为 $1$。Kay 对这棵树的结构非常感兴趣。

经过一番研究，他提出了 $*q*$ 个感兴趣的询问。第 $*i*$ 个询问要求找出节点 $*v*_{*i*}$ 的子树的一个重心。你的任务是回答所有询问。

节点的*子树*是由该节点及其所有后代节点（无论直接后代还是间接后代）组成的树的一部分。换句话说，节点 $*v*$ 的子树由满足以下条件的节点 $*u*$ 组成：节点 $*v*$ 位于从 $*u*$ 到根节点的路径上。

树（或子树）的*重心*是这样一个节点：从树中删除它后，所得最大连通块的大小不超过原树（或子树）大小的一半。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*q*$（$2 ≤ *n* ≤ 300 000$，$1 ≤ *q* ≤ 300 000$）——原树的大小以及询问的数量。

第二行包含 $*n*$ - 1 个整数 $*p*_{2}, *p*_{3}, ..., *p*_{*n*}$（$1 ≤ *p*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$）——编号为 $2$ 至 $*n*$ 的节点的父节点编号。节点 $1$ 是树的根节点。保证 $*p*_{*i*}$ 定义了一棵合法的树。

接下来的 $*q*$ 行中，每行包含一个整数 $*v*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *v*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$）——定义待求重心子树的节点编号。

## 输出格式

对于每个询问，输出对应子树的一个重心的编号。如果有多个符合条件的节点，输出其中任意一个即可。保证每棵子树都至少有一个重心。

## 说明

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b6d1f35b3db16b3f662d8b452206abbdeb5d0aa4.png)

第一个询问要求找出整棵树的一个重心，即节点 $3$。如果删除节点 $3$，树将分裂成四个连通块，其中两个大小为 $1$，另外两个大小为 $2$。

第二个节点的子树只包含它自身，因此答案是 $2$。

节点 $3$ 是其自身子树的重心。

节点 $5$ 的子树的重心为节点 $5$ 和节点 $6$，因此这两个答案均被视为正确答案。
